note: Checks the shape of the acceptance criteria only. Whether the criteria cover a happy path, an edge case and a negative case is not checked (it needs a judge); the scenario count is a rough proxy.

cases.prompt: This is a checklist item from a feature request for a CSV event importer: "- [ ] System handles parsing errors and displays clear messages". Write the acceptance criteria for it.
Write the acceptance criteria for this story: "As a customer I want to apply a discount code at checkout so that I pay less."
